title: The receipt flow strands its sheet busy when a read or confirm rejects
body:
## Summary
app/(studio)/projects/_plan/receipt.tsx `useReceipt` awaits spec.read / spec.confirm with try/finally but no catch: a Server Action whose round trip fails rejects, and the hunt render and the batch (both in this pair) open their receipts through it.

## Description
open() (receipt.tsx:74-81) clears `reading` in its finally, but the rejection escapes as an unhandled rejection and spec.failed never runs, so the operator sees nothing. arm() (:96-107) and confirm() (:116-127) set `{ ...st, busy: true }` and only clear busy on an answer: a rejected re-read or confirm leaves the sheet busy (Confirm dead) until it is closed. Hunt.tsx render() and Batch.tsx price() pass `acts.renderLeaves` / `acts.batchReceipt` straight through. Fixed looks like: each await in the hook goes through a settle (the shape of app/(studio)/audio/_hunt/settled.ts, eed4e9b3) so a rejection is `failed(words)` on open and `error: words, busy: false` on arm/confirm.

## Flow
- press Render on a hunt, or Price on a batch, with the network dropping mid-request
- spec.read rejects -> open()'s finally clears reading; no toast, unhandled rejection
- on an open sheet, Arm live / Confirm rejects -> busy stays true, the sheet is dead

## Expected impact
Every receipt launch on the studio (projects, hunt, batch, floor) names a failed round trip instead of going silent or dead. Could break: nothing that relies on a rejection escaping the hook.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - a rejected receipt read or confirm is a refusal with its words
Before: 0 of 3 awaits in useReceipt settle on a rejection (read in open, read in arm, confirm)
After: 3 of 3
Method: simulation - receipt.tsx is outside this pair's paths (veto 1); counted by reading the three awaits
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
app/(studio)/projects/_plan/receipt.tsx:74-81 (open: try/finally, no catch), :96-107 (arm: busy set, cleared only on an answer), :116-127 (confirm: same)
app/(studio)/audio/_hunt/Hunt.tsx render() -> flow.open({ read: acts.renderLeaves ... })
app/(studio)/audio/_insight/Batch.tsx price() -> flow.open({ read: acts.batchReceipt ... })
instrument: export the hook's await wrapper (or a pure settle) and a vitest case: a spec whose read rejects calls failed(words); a source ratchet that receipt.tsx's three awaits go through it; seed red on HEAD receipt.tsx

title: A stalled hunt return upload holds its leaf in `returning` with no deadline
body:
## Summary
app/(studio)/audio/_hunt/returnClient.ts uploadLeafReturn fetches with no signal or deadline, so an upload that stalls (no answer, no error) keeps its leaf's drop in `returning` forever.

## Description
Hunt.tsx fileBack (:86-103) adds the leaf to `returning` and removes it only in the upload's `.then`; uploadLeafReturn (returnClient.ts:19-27) catches a fetch that throws but sets no AbortSignal, so a request the server never answers (a stalled connection, a proxy that holds it) never settles. The route's own maxDuration (60 s) bounds the server side, not a connection that never reaches it. A second drop on the leaf is refused while it is `returning`. Fixed looks like: AbortSignal.timeout on the fetch, scaled to the 60 MB cap at a stated minimum rate, and the refusal names the deadline.

## Flow
- drop a file on a Suno leaf; the connection stalls
- fetch never resolves or rejects
- the leaf stays returning; a second drop on it does nothing

## Expected impact
A stalled upload is refused with words and the leaf takes a retry without a reload. Could break: a slow but live upload of a large WAV cut off by too short a deadline - the deadline is a judgement the worker must size.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - a stalled upload settles
Before: 0 of 1 upload paths carry a deadline
After: 1 of 1
Method: simulation - no instrument in the round can stall a fetch; the deadline's size needs a measured upload rate
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
app/(studio)/audio/_hunt/returnClient.ts:19 `fetch("/audio/hunt-return", { method: "POST", body: form, credentials: "same-origin" })` - no signal
app/(studio)/audio/_hunt/Hunt.tsx:86-103 fileBack: `returning` cleared only in .then
instrument: vitest case over uploadLeafReturn with a stubbed global fetch that never settles and fake timers: Before = the promise is still pending after the deadline; After = { ok: false, error: <names the deadline> }
